contract_name: E165 experiment-owned logical score report input and output
phase: AUDIT-only; build_report consumes the normalized report payload after scores and cohort lock are fixed

input.source_identity_sha256: Required non-empty string identifying the frozen source set; this report layer does not resolve or hash files.
input.cohort_lock_sha256: Required 64-character SHA256 hex digest binding the sealed 16-prefix cohort.

prefix_item.seed: Integer equal to the item position in prefix_seed_order; booleans are rejected.
prefix_item.prepared_id: Required non-empty string shared by C, D, S0, and S1 metrics for this prefix.
prefix_item.b: Finite numeric original C0 new-train-KL bound for this prefix.

training.D: Object with all four required fields below.
training.S0: Object with all four required fields below.
training.S1: Object with all four required fields below.
training.value_provenance: Each value is the saved training component for the final float32 candidate, accurately converted to float64. The report validates presence and finiteness; it cannot establish this provenance itself.

candidate_sha256.D: Required 64-character SHA256 hex digest of D candidate parameter bytes.
candidate_sha256.S0: Required 64-character SHA256 hex digest of S0 candidate parameter bytes.
candidate_sha256.S1: Required 64-character SHA256 hex digest of S1 candidate parameter bytes.

metrics.C: The original C h036_score_metrics_v1 object, lambda_value 0.
metrics.D: The original D h036_score_metrics_v1 object, lambda_value 1.

references.C: Required non-empty object preserving the original C artifact reference.
references.D: Required non-empty object preserving the original D artifact reference.
references.S0: Required non-empty object preserving the S0 score/artifact reference.
references.S1: Required non-empty object preserving the S1 score/artifact reference.

score_metrics.seed: Must equal the containing logical prefix seed.
score_metrics.prepared_id: Must equal the containing prefix prepared_id; C, D, S0, and S1 must match exactly.

identity_and_value_checks.numeric_policy: Required score/training scalars are finite JSON numbers; reject booleans, NaN, and infinities.
identity_and_value_checks.G_new: Exactly equals K_new_W0 - K_new and encoded-fresh holdout W0_fresh.new_holdout - encoded_fresh.new_holdout.
identity_and_value_checks.W0_baseline: For each prefix, C, D, S0, and S1 W0_fresh old/new train/holdout values must all match exactly. Each G_new view/split uses that metric object's same-split W0_fresh new value minus the arm's new value.
identity_and_value_checks.missing_fields: Reject any missing required prefix, training, score, legacy, view, split, origin, or reference field.

input.numeric_policy: Finite JSON integers/floats only for required numeric values; booleans are not numbers.
input.additional_input_keys: Not consumed by the report. Required canonical h036 fields and provenance objects are validated as stated.

report.comparison_rows: Each of the two comparison objects has per_prefix rows with seed, prepared_id, source references/candidate identities, training_changes, old_kl_changes, G_new_changes, and encoded_holdout_joint_direction.

training_comparison_fields.per_prefix: For each comparison and prefix, preserve from/to values and signed/absolute differences for fullL, new_train_kl, old_train_kl, and ridge.
training_comparison_fields.summary: Inside each comparison summary.training, report 16-prefix mean signed difference and mean absolute difference for every field. Do not assign a standalone better/worse direction to ridge.

score_comparisons.per_prefix: For every fixed metric/view/split, preserve signed delta (to minus from), absolute delta, and improved/degraded/unchanged classification.
score_comparisons.summary: Inside each comparison summary.old_kl / summary.G_new, report the full-16 mean signed delta, mean absolute delta, and improved/degraded/unchanged counts for every fixed metric/view/split. Unchanged means exact delta == 0; no tolerance.

encoded_holdout_joint_direction_diagnost.definition: Per-prefix and count within each comparison: encoded-fresh holdout old-KL delta < 0 and G_new delta > 0.
encoded_holdout_joint_direction_diagnost.interpretation: Descriptive direction only; no threshold or advancement rule.

final32_witness.comparison_basis: S1 relative to D only; S1-S0 receives differences/directions only and has no witness predicate.
per_prefix_required_conditions: S1 candidate_sha256 differs from D candidate_sha256.
final32_witness.output: Preserve each condition as a boolean, per-prefix witnessed boolean, and full-16 witness_count. This reporting threshold does not select candidates or create a new candidate.

encoded_train_bound_diagnostic.per_prefix: Report K, b, signed_excess=K-b, violation=max(0,K-b), and feasible_with_tolerance=(K <= b + 1e-12).
encoded_train_bound_diagnostic.summary: Report feasible count, mean signed excess, and mean violation separately for S0 and S1.
encoded_train_bound_diagnostic.prohibited: Do not compute or require an additional encoded C0 score/baseline.

encoded_holdout_joint_direction_diagnost.definition: Descriptive only: for a given comparison, encoded-fresh holdout old-KL delta < 0 and G_new delta > 0.
encoded_holdout_joint_direction_diagnost.output: Preserve per-prefix booleans and count for S1-S0 and S1-D; no automatic threshold or advancement rule.

C_reference_summary.per_prefix: Retain all 16 seed/prepared_id/reference entries, canonical C h036 score fields, legacy K_old/K_new/K_new_W0/G_new, all required raw W0 view values, and derived old_kl/G_new values used by this report.

descriptive_ratios.S1_G_new_over_C_G_new: Defined only when C.G_new > 1e-10. G_new is a KL-derived diagnostic, not reward.

C_reference_summary.ratio_summary: For each ratio, report defined count, full logical-prefix count, and mean over defined values (null if none). Keep all C per-prefix values even when a ratio is undefined.

prohibited: Any upgrade, advancement, or progression decision.
A 12/16 gate or any other sample-count gate.
Reward conclusion or treating G_new/W0-derived gain as reward.
Treating metrics, views, arms, or artifacts within one seed as independent samples.
An encoded C0 score or an additional baseline comparison.

execution_boundary.report_module: Pure Python standard library/math; report construction only.
execution_boundary.local_work: Text/code/document editing and static syntax/JSON inspection only; do not import or call report.py locally.
execution_boundary.authorized_use: Only the separately admitted remote AUDIT phase may call build_report after the exact payload is bound.
execution_boundary.scientific_runtime: No scoring, model access, artifact loading, candidate recovery, fitting, or audit execution in this module.
